content: Sɔ̃ɔ teeru kurɔ ɡoo u nɑ Eliseen mi. N deemɑ win durɔ u rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔn bwɑ̃ɑbu wuuru sɔɔ. Yerɑ kurɔ wi, u Elisee nɔɔɡiru sue u nɛɛ, wee nɛn durɔ wi u sɑ̃ɑ wunɛn sɔm kowo u ɡu. A mɑɑ yɛ̃ mɑ u Yinni Gusunɔ nɑsie. Yerɑ u durɔ ɡoon dibu nɛni. Durɔ wiyɑ u nɑ u nɛn bibu yiru mwɑ. U bu kuɑ yobu.
Yerɑ Elisee u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ kon kpĩ n nun kuɑ. A mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɔ ye ɑ mɔ yɛnuɔ. Mɑ kurɔ wi, u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, nɑ ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnu mɔ yɛnuɔ, mɑ n kun mɔ ɡum fiiko ɑkpɑrɑbɑ sɔɔ.
Mɑ Elisee u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo ɑ ɡbɛ̃ɑ bɔkurɑ wunɛn berusebu kpuron mi kpɑ ɑ kɑ nu nɑ dɑbi dɑbinu.
À n turɑ wunɛn yɛnuɔ, ɑ duo wunɛn dirɔ kɑ wunɛn bibu kpuro i tii diru kɛnusi. Yen biru kpɑ ɑ ɡum mɛ wisi wisi ɡbɛ̃ɛ ni sɔɔ. Nin ni nu yibɑ kpɑ ɑ ni yi bee tiɑ.
Sɑɑ yerɑ kurɔ wi, u seewɑ u Elisee deri. Mɑ u dɑ u tii ɡɑmbo kɛnusi wi kɑ win bibu. Mɑ bii be, bɑ nùn ɡbɛ̃ɛ ni tĩimɔ u ɡum mɛ wisimɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ ɡbɛ̃ɛ ni, nu yibɑ yerɑ u win bii turo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑɑ mɑn ɡbɛ̃ɛru wɛ̃ɛmɑ. Yerɑ bii wi, u nɛɛ, ɡbɛ̃ɑ kpɑ. Mɑ ɡum mɛ, mu yɔ̃rɑ.
Yen biruwɑ u dɑ u Elisee deemɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ ye yɑ koorɑ. Mɑ Elisee u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo ɑ ɡum mɛ dɔrɑ kpɑ ɑ kɑ mɛn ɡobi dii bi kɔsiɑ. Kpɑ ɑ yi yi tie yi, i n dimɔ i n kɑ wɑ̃ɑ wunɛ kɑ wunɛn bibu.
Elisee kɑ kurɔ ɡobiɡii
wi u wɑ̃ɑ Sunɛmuɔ
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Elisee u sɑrɔ Sunɛmuɔ. N deemɑ kurɔ ɡobiɡii ɡoo wɑ̃ɑ mi, mɑ kurɔ wi, u nùn suuru kɑnɑ u nɑ u di win mi. Sɑɑ mɑɑ dɔmɑ ten di, ù n sɑrɔ mi, miyɑ u rɑ ɡɛre u di.
Yerɑ kurɔ wi, u win durɔ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, durɔ wi u rɑ sɑre mini, Gusunɔn tɔn dɛɛrowɑ u sɑ̃ɑ.
A de su ɡidɑmbisɑ bɑni bɛsɛn dirun wɔllɔ. Kpɑ su kpinu doke mi kɑ tɑbulu kɑ kitɑru kɑ fitilɑ. Kpɑ durɔ wi, u n dɑ n wɑ̃ɑ mi, ù n nɑ.
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Elisee u mɑɑ wurɑ mi, yerɑ u deemɑ bɑ ye kpuro bɑnɑ. Mɑ u dɑ u kpunɑ mi.
Mɑ u win sɔm kowo ɑluwɑɑsi wi bɑ rɑ soku Gehɑsi ɡɔrɑ u dɑ u kurɔ wi sokumɑ. Yerɑ u dɑ u nùn sokɑ. Mɑ kurɔ wi, u nɑ u yɔ̃rɑ Eliseen wuswɑɑɔ.

Elisee u Gehɑsi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ kurɔ wi sɔ̃, wee u sun bɛɛrɛ doke nɛ kɑ wunɛ. Tɛ̃ mbɑ u kĩ su nùn kuɑ. U kĩ su win durom mɛ u sun kuɑ sinɑ boko sɔ̃? Ǹ kun mɛ tɑbu sunɔ? Adɑmɑ kurɔ wi, u wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ wɑ̃ɑwɑ mini kɑ bɔri yɛndu nɛn tɔmbun suunu sɔɔ.
Yen biru Elisee u Gehɑsi bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ sɑ ko kpĩ su kurɔ wi kuɑ. Gehɑsi u wisɑ u nɛɛ, u ǹ bii mɑrure, win durɔ mɑɑ sere tɔkɔ kuɑ.
Elisee u nɛɛ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ nùn sokumɑ. Mɑ Gehɑsi u nùn sokɑ u nɑ u yɔ̃rɑ dii kɔnnɔwɔ.
Elisee u kurɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɡɑsɔku ɑmɑdɑɑre, kɑɑ bii tɔn durɔ tɑɑru swĩi. Yerɑ kurɔ wi, u nɛɛ, yinni, ɑ ku mɑn nɔni wɔ̃ke, domi ɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Gusunɔn tɔnu.
Yen biruwɑ kurɔ wi, u ɡurɑ suɑ u bii tɔn durɔ mɑrɑ wɔ̃ɔ kpɔɔ ɡe sɔɔ, ɡe Elisee u nùn burɑ.
Elisee
u kurɔ ɡobiɡii win bii seeyɑ
Bii wi, u kpɛ̃ɑ. Sɔ̃ɔ teeru ye u yɑrɑ u dɑ mi win tundo u wɑ̃ɑ kɑ win sɔm kowobu bɑ dobi ɡɛ̃ɛmɔ.
Yerɑ u win tundo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn wirɑ mɑn dumɔ, nɛn wirɑ mɑn dumɔ. Mɑ tundo u win sɔm kowo turo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ kɑ nùn doo win mɛron mi fuuku.
Sɑɑ yerɑ u bii wi suɑ u kɑ dɑ. Mɑ mɛro u nùn suɑ u tɑɑru sɔndi. Sere n kɑ ko sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ, bii wi, u ɡu.
Mɑ kurɔ wi, u yɔɔwɑ dii te bɑ Elisee kuɑn mi, u bii ɡoo te kpĩ win kpin yerɔ. Mɑ u tu ɡɑmbo kɛnusi u sɑrɑmɑ.
Yen biru u win durɔ sokɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑn sɔm kowo ben turo kɛ̃ɛmɑ kɑ kɛtɛku teu. Nɑ kon dukɑ dɑ Eliseen mi, n wurɑmɑ tɛ̃.
Durɔ wi, u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ dɔɔ win mi ɡisɔ. Domi suru kpɑo kun yɑrɑ. Tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡirɑ kun mɑɑ turɑ. Adɑmɑ kurɔ wi, u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɡɑm sɑri.
Yen biru u derɑ bɑ kɛtɛku ɡɑɑri bɔkuɑ. Mɑ u sɔm kowo wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ kɑ mɑn doo ɑ ku yɔ̃rɑ ɡɑm, mɑ n kun mɔ nɑ nɛɛ, ɑ yɔ̃ro.
Mɑ bɑ dɑ mi Elisee u wɑ̃ɑ ɡuu te bɑ mɔ̀ Kɑɑmɛliɔ. Ye u kurɔ wi wɛndɛ kuɑ, yerɑ u win bɔ̃ɔ ɑluwɑɑsi Gehɑsi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, kurɔ Sunɛmuɡii wi wee, u wee.
A dukɑ doo ɑ kɑ nùn yinnɑ. A nùn bikiɑ ɑ nɛɛ, u bwɑ̃ɑ do? Win durɔ mɑɑ ni? Bii wi, u ɑlɑfiɑ mɔ? Yɛnuɡibu kpuro bɑ bwɑ̃ɑ do? Ye u nùn bikiɑ mɛ, mɑ kurɔ wi, u wisɑ u nɛɛ, sɑ bwɑ̃ɑ do kpuro ɡbɑ̃ɑ ɡbɑ̃ɑ.

Ye kurɔ wi, u turɑ mi Elisee u wɑ̃ɑ ɡuu ten wɔllɔ, yerɑ u win nɑɑsu sɛ̃re. Mɑ Gehɑsi u susi u kɑ nùn bɔriɑ. Mɑ Elisee u nɛɛ, ɑ nùn derio. Domi u wɑ̃ɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu sɔɔ. Nɑ ǹ mɑɑ yɛ̃ mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ. Domi Yinni Gusunɔ kun mɑn ye sɔ̃ɔsi.
Yerɑ kurɔ wi, u Elisee sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn yinni, nɑ nun bii bikiɑ? Nɑ ǹ dɑɑ nun sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, ɑ ku mɑn nɔni wɔ̃ke?

Mɑ Elisee u Gehɑsi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ tii suo kpɑ ɑ nɛn dɛkɑ suɑ ɑ n nɛni ɑ dɑ kurɔ win yɛnuɔ. À n kɑ ɡoo yinnɑ swɑɑɔ, ɑ ku yɔ̃rɑ ɑ yɛ̃ro tɔbiri. Goo ù n mɑɑ nun tɔburɑ, ɑ ku nùn wurɑri. À n turɑ mi, ɑ nɛn dɛkɑ ye sɔndio bii win wuswɑɑɔ.
Mɑ bii win mɛro u nɛɛ, sere kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wɑ̃ɑru kɑ mɑɑ wunɛn tiiɡiru, nɑ ǹ nun derimɔ n doonɑ minin di. Yerɑ Elisee u seewɑ u bu swĩi.

Gehɑsi u bu ɡbiiyɑ u doonɑ. Ye u turɑ mi, yerɑ u dɛkɑ ye suɑ u sɔndi bii win wuswɑɑɔ. Adɑmɑ bii wi kun kusunu kue u sere nɛɛ, u koo ɡɑri ɡere. Yen biru Gehɑsi u ɡɔsirɑ u kɑ Elisee yinnɑ. U nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bii wi kun seewe.
Ye Elisee u duɑ diru mi, u deemɑ wee bii ɡoo te, tɑ kpĩ win kpin yerɔ.
Yerɑ u tii ɡɑmbo kɛnusi u Yinni Gusunɔ kɑnɑ.
Mɑ u bii wi kibɑrisi, u win nɔɔ ɡirɑri win nɔɔwɔ. U win nɔni ɡirɑri win nɔniɔ. Mɑ u mɑɑ win nɔmɑ sɔndi win nɔmɑɔ. Mɛyɑ u bii wi kibɑrisi sere win wɑsi yi kɑ swĩɑ.
Elisee u seewɑ bii win wɔllun di. Mɑ u ɡinɑ sĩɑ sĩɑ dii te sɔɔ. Yen biru u mɑɑ wurɑmɑ u nùn kibɑrisi. Bii wi, u sũɑ nɔn nɔɔbɑ yiru, mɑ u nɔni wukiɑ.
Yerɑ Elisee u Gehɑsi sokɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo ɑ kurɔ wi sokumɑ. Mɑ Gehɑsi u dɑ u nùn sokumɑ. Ye kurɔ wi, u tunumɑ Eliseen mi, yerɑ Elisee u nɛɛ, ɑ wunɛn bii suo.
Mɑ u yiirɑ Eliseen nuurɔ u wiru tem ɡirɑri, yen biru u win bii suɑ u yɑrɑ.
Kpee yi yi ǹ diirɔ

Yenibɑn biru, Elisee u wurɑmɑ Giliɡɑliɔ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, ɡɔ̃ɔrɑ wɑ̃ɑ tem mi. Mɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔn bwɑ̃ɑbun wuuru tɑ sɔ̃ win wuswɑɑɔ. Yerɑ u win sɔm kowo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ weke bɑkɑru sɔndio ɑ sɔmɔ be kpee sɑɑwɑ.
Yerɑ sɔmɔ ben turo u seewɑ u kpee yorim dɑ yɑkɑsɔ. Yerɑ u kɑɑru ɡɑrun mɑrum wɑ resɛm yɑkɑsuɡiɑ sɔɔ. Mɑ u mu yorɑ u bɔɔru yibiɑ. Ye u turɑ yɛnuɔ yerɑ u mu bɔɔrɑ u kpɛ̃ɛ kpee yi sɔɔ. Domi bɑ ǹ mu yɛ̃.
Mɑ bɑ tɔmbu wɛ̃ bu kɑ di. Adɑmɑ sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ ye dɑburɑ bɑ nɔɔɡiru suɑ bɑ nɛɛ, dɛ̃ɛ wɑ̃ɑ kpee yi sɔɔ, Yinni Gusunɔn sɔmɔ wunɛ! Goo kun kpĩɑ u mɑɑ yi di.

Yerɑ Elisee u win sɔm kowo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ seewo ɑ som suɑ ɑ doke kpee weke te sɔɔ. Mɑ sɔm kowo wi, u kuɑ mɛ. Yerɑ Elisee u mɑɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ yi tɔmbu wɛ̃ɛyɔ bu di. Domi ɡɑ̃ɑ kɔ̃sunu kun mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ kpee yi sɔɔ.
Elisee u tɔmbu wunɔbu diisiɑ

Yenibɑn biru, durɔ ɡoo u nɑ sɑɑ Bɑɑli Sɑlisɑn di u kɑ Elisee pɛ̃ɛ nɑɑwɑ, ye bɑ kuɑ kɑ ɔɔsun som kpɑm kɑ sere mɑɑ dĩɑ bimi kpɛɛ ɡɛɛn sɑɑki tiɑ. Yerɑ Elisee u win sɔm kowo sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, u ye bɔnu koowo tɔn be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ min sɔ̃.

Adɑmɑ sɔm kowo wi, u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ kon kpĩ n kɑ dĩɑ nini tɔmbu wunɔbu (100) diisiɑ. Mɑ Elisee u mɑɑ nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ye tɔn be kpuro bɔnu kuo. Domi Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, bɑɑwure u koo wɑ u di, kpɑ nu tiɑrɑ.
Mɑ Eliseen sɔm kowo wi, u pɛ̃ɛ ye, tɔn be bɔnu kuɑ. Ben bɑɑwure u wɑ u di. Mɑ sukum tiɑ nɡe mɛ Yinni Gusunɔ u ɡeruɑ.
Nɑmɑni u bɛkurɑ
